official_slogan_en: Measured where measured. Reconstructed where necessary. Never invented.
official_slogan_nl: Echt gemeten. Echt gereconstrueerd. Geen verzinsels.

core_vision.sealed_house: Original RAW/CFA + capture metadata remain immutable measurement evidence.
core_vision.new_house: Latent Scene Truth / Scene Master is a separate reconstructed state and is not constrained by arbitrary source-container representation limits.
core_vision.representation_boundary: Representation can exceed the source. Knowledge claims cannot exceed the evidence.
core_vision.full_physical_role: FULL_PHYSICAL is an evidence/certification scope, not an architectural permission boundary.

zero_line_truthrange.zero_line: T=0 is a chosen positive-light reference/gauge L0; it is not sensor black, absolute darkness or clipping.
zero_line_truthrange.calibration_role: Calibration places evidence and uncertainty on the coordinate; it does not define the permitted ceiling/floor of the master address space.
zero_line_truthrange.iso_role: ISO/gain is immutable capture provenance and source-model state, not reconstructed-scene identity.
zero_line_truthrange.high_censor_rule: WhiteLevel clipping yields a finite TruthRange lower bound with upper=+infinity unless narrowed by valid additional evidence/model support.
zero_line_truthrange.dark_rule: Noise-limited darkness may yield lower=-infinity with a finite evidence-dependent upper bound; exact zero light is not inferred from noise alone.
zero_line_truthrange.dual_coordinate_rule: Keep signed scene-linear reconstruction and positive-light TruthRange as distinct companion coordinates.
zero_line_truthrange.permanent_boundary: The axis can be infinite. The evidence is finite. Reconstruction beyond evidence remains reconstruction.

zero_line_v0_1_validation.source_domain: HONOR BKQ-N49 BnCam tele 22.48mm f/2.6 4080x3072 BGGR
zero_line_v0_1_validation.next: Bind TruthRange to exact Stage-2/Latent Scene Master plus backend uncertainty and replace the provisional ISO*exposure proxy where stronger measured gain mapping exists.
